projects.title: MOTION.VER.01
projects.description: A customized Notion-like productivity platform designed for engineering teams to manage projects, track thermodynamics data, and optimize sustainability workflows.
keyFeatures: Custom database schema for engineering data
projects.problem: Engineering teams lacked a unified platform to track complex thermodynamics data alongside project status, leading to fragmented information and slowed sustainability initiatives.
projects.solution: Developed a custom, Notion-like application tailored for engineering workflows, featuring a robust database schema for tracking technical metrics in real-time and providing actionable sustainability insights via a dedicated dashboard.
projects.learnings: Deepened understanding of real-time state management and database optimization for complex data structures.

projects.title: Bio-Energy Tracker
projects.description: An interactive dashboard for monitoring biomass energy production and carbon offset metrics in real-time.
projects.problem: Bio-energy plants needed a way to visualize production data and carbon offsets to optimize operations.
projects.solution: Built a Python-based tracker with D3.js for high-fidelity data visualization.
projects.learnings: Improved skills in D3.js and handling real-time data streams.

projects.title: Hydrogen Storage Simulator
projects.description: A simulation tool for modeling thermodynamic properties and storage efficiency of hydrogen fuel cells.
projects.problem: Researchers needed a more accessible way to run complex hydrogen storage simulations without deep coding knowledge.
projects.solution: Created a web-based simulator combining Python's scientific libraries with a modern React frontend.
projects.learnings: Learned how to bridge complex backend simulations with user-friendly frontend interfaces.
